I didn't find any bugs or security problems in this change. The findings are about repo conventions, one product gap and one missing test. There's nothing that must be fixed before you open the PR.

**How this ran:** I read the whole diff myself instead of running the full nine-agent pipeline, and no second agent checked the findings. So this is a draft with no score. I didn't modify any files, run tests, install anything or use `gh`.

- **Scope:** 10 files, +498 −11, from `0bd81ad` to `97ae7fc` (2 commits). All in `apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/Policies/`.
- **Repo:** Web, TypeScript/React, jest + RTL, shadcn. Rules taken from root `AGENTS.md`, `apps/web/AGENTS.md` and `docs/ai/testing-conventions.md`.

## Findings

| # | Priority | Area | Where | Finding |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | P2 | Conventions | `SpendingLimitIntroDialog/constants.ts:1`, `SpendingLimitPreview.tsx:7,24,57`, `SpendingLimitIntroDialog/index.tsx:10,38,43`, `Policies/index.tsx:25,37`, `Policies.stories.tsx:11,25`, `SpendingLimitIntroDialog.stories.tsx:29` | Too many long comments (see below). |
| 2 | P3 | Conventions | `SpendingLimitIntroDialog/__tests__/SpendingLimitIntroDialog.test.tsx:21` | A comment sits above an `it(...)`. `docs/ai/testing-conventions.md` says: "No comments above test cases". |
| 3 | P3 | Bugs / product | `Policies/PolicyCatalogue/catalogue.ts:19`, `Policies/index.tsx:16-18,44-47` | The tile is now clickable but leads nowhere after the first time (see below). |
| 4 | P3 | Testing | `Policies/__tests__/Policies.test.tsx:73-109` | The page-level path for "Set up spending limit" (`proceedToSpendingLimitFlow`) isn't tested (see below). |
| 5 | P3 | Conventions | `SpendingLimitIntroDialog/index.tsx:89` | `dark:text-black` is a hard-coded colour. `apps/web/AGENTS.md:11` says to use theme variables. |

**1. Long comments.** Root `AGENTS.md` says comments should be one line, rare, and only explain a non-obvious why. It also says never write multi-paragraph comment blocks or justify a change to the reviewer. This diff adds about 15 comment blocks, most of them 2–5 lines, and several narrate the design, e.g. the 5-line JSDoc on a single key in `constants.ts`. Fix: cut each block to one line, or delete it. `index.tsx:43` (why focus starts on the button) and `SpendingLimitPreview.tsx:83` (why `aria-hidden`) are worth keeping as one-liners.

**3. Clickable tile with nothing behind it.** `isAvailable` is now `true`, so analytics records `IS_AVAILABLE: true` for this tile. But `startSpendingLimitFlow` is an empty TODO (WA-3150).
- "Set up spending limit" only closes the dialog and records the intro as seen.
- From the second click on, the tile does nothing.
- The risk is small: the page is behind `FEATURES.POLICIES` (`pages/spaces/policies.tsx:14`), and the Proposer tile already works the same way.
- Fix: keep `FEATURES.POLICIES` off in production until WA-3150 lands. Or don't record the intro as seen when "Set up spending limit" is clicked while the flow is still empty.

**4. Missing page-level test for "Set up spending limit".** The dialog test only checks that `onProceed` fires. If `Policies/index.tsx:45` stopped calling `closeSpendingLimitIntro()`, no test would fail. Fix: add a case to `Policies.test.tsx` that clicks "Set up spending limit" and checks the dialog closes and `setHasSeenSpendingLimitIntro(true)` is called.

**5. Hard-coded colour.** In the dark shadcn scope, `--primary-foreground` is `#0a0a0a` (`styles/shadcn.css:108`). So `dark:text-primary-foreground` gives the same result using a token.

## Checked, nothing found
- **Security:** no untrusted input. Links are fixed help-centre constants, and "seen" is only a browser-wide boolean in localStorage.
- **Regression:** the `PolicyCatalogue` tests were updated to use Account recovery as the unavailable tile. Nothing was removed without a replacement.
- **Bugs:** `useLocalStorage` loads its saved value on mount, before any click can happen. Every way of dismissing the dialog goes through `onOpenChange(false)`, which records it as seen. Default of `false` when nothing is stored is correct.
- **Tokens:** `bg-surface-sunken` and `badge-dot-success` exist in the shadcn theme; `--color-background-light-hover` and `--color-static-text-brand` exist in `vars.css`. `DialogContent` supports `size="xs"`.
- **Architecture / performance:** the component sits in the right feature folder with no new coupling. The render cost is a fixed illustration.

## Not covered
- No tests or type-check were run, as you asked.
- No agents independently checked or tried to disprove the findings, so there's no score.
- I didn't do a visual or Figma comparison.

**Tidy-ups:** finding 1 is the main one. Nothing else in the touched files needs tidying.
